properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/outage-entry-validation-prod'
| fields @timestamp, intent, sent_to_sqs_flag
| stats count() as total, sum(sent_to_sqs_flag) as successful by bin(5m), intent
properties.title: Request Volume by Intent

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/outage-entry-validation-prod'
| fields @timestamp, sent_to_sqs_flag
| stats count() as total, sum(sent_to_sqs_flag) as successful, (sum(sent_to_sqs_flag) * 100.0 / count()) as success_rate
properties.title: Validation Success Rate

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/outage-entry-validation-prod'
| fields @timestamp, ticket_id, intent, processing_status, error_type
| filter sent_to_sqs_flag = 0
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 20
properties.title: Recent Validation Failures
